div.head: Iudex Iudex 1
div.ab: Ælc man, þe riht demeð, he hæfð wæga on handa; 7 on ægðere sceale he byrþ rihtwisnesse 7 mildheortnesse: ærest for ðære rihtwisnesse he gereceð ðæs gyltes bote 7 þonne for ðære mildheortnesse he gemetegað þære scylde wíte.

Every man who judges justly holds a balance in his hand: on each scale he carries justice and mercy: first, for the sake of justice he decides the punishment for the guilty, and then for the sake of mercy he moderates the pain of the penalty.
Omnis iudex iustus misericordiam et iudicium libret in omnibus, ut inprimis per rectam scientiam dicat emendationem secundum culpam et eam tamen admensuret propter indulgentiam.
